facts.fact: The OGP page for commitment LR0036, citing the IRM report on interviews and a site visit in October 2018, says the national data portal (eLiberia) was live but not formally launched, with links to ministry and agency sites and an unpopulated data repository page; the document ties it to no open data policy.

systems.system: Open Data/Citizen Navigation Portal (OGP commitment LR0036)

note: The commitment to build an open data platform is an OGP action-plan item (2017-2019) that the IRM rates not started; it states no open data policy, so no standing fact.
